reasoning: The tomato plants show extensive pale/white bleaching of the main stems extending from the base upward, with complete plant wilt and collapse. This pattern of stem tissue bleaching and whitening with whole-plant death is characteristic of Sclerotinia sclerotiorum (timber rot), which kills and bleaches stem cortex tissue causing plant collapse. Southern Blight is the main differential but typically causes more localized damage at the soil line rather than the extensive upward stem bleaching seen here.
